definition: 统计周期内支付成功且未退款的订单金额合计（不含运费）
formula: SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM f_orders o WHERE o.pay_status='paid' AND o.refund_status='none'

definition: 成交总额扣除退款、折扣与平台佣金后的金额
formula: SUM(o.pay_amount - o.refund_amount - o.discount_amount - o.commission_amount) FROM f_orders o

definition: 统计周期内成交总额除以支付订单数
formula: SUM(o.pay_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM f_orders o

definition: 毛利额占净收入比例，毛利额=净收入-商品成本
formula: SUM(o.pay_amount - o.cost_amount) / SUM(o.pay_amount) FROM f_orders o

definition: 统计周期内有登录或下单行为的去重用户数
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM f_user_events e LEFT JOIN f_orders o ON e.user_id = o.user_id

definition: 统计周期内下单次数大于等于2次的用户占下单用户比例
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.cnt >= 2 THEN c.user_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) FROM (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM f_orders GROUP BY user_id) c

definition: 支付订单数除以访问会话数
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.session_id) FROM f_orders o JOIN f_sessions s ON o.session_id = s.session_id

definition: 统计周期平均库存金额除以日均销售成本
formula: AVG(i.stock_amount) / AVG(o.cost_amount) FROM f_inventory_snapshot i JOIN f_orders o ON o.paid_at = i.snapshot_date

definition: 缺货 SKU 数占在售 SKU 数比例
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.on_hand_qty = 0 THEN s.sku_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.sku_id) FROM f_sku_stock s

definition: 按承诺时间交付的订单数占总交付订单数比例
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivered_at <= d.promised_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM f_delivery d

definition: 退款订单数占支付订单数比例
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.refund_status <> 'none' THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM f_orders o

definition: 按时完成产出的数据任务数占应产出任务数比例
formula: SUM(CASE WHEN j.finished_at <= j.sla_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) FROM f_job_run j
